scenes.vo: Last night, the thing on the camera got close enough to touch me. Tonight, I came in early.
Walt worked here before me. If anyone knew the rules, it was him. I lifted the old cash register off the counter.
Underneath, taped to the wood, was a folded note, yellow with age. The handwriting shook, like he wrote it in a hurry.
Rule one. Never look at the monitor after three. Rule two. When the lights go out, stay BEHIND the counter.
Behind me, the monitor clicked on by itself. Camera three. For the first time all week, the aisle was EMPTY.
My hands were shaking. I looked back at the note. There was one more line. Rule three was scratched out.
